# The Design Dude Studio (TDDS)

> High-impact creative studio based in Ahmedabad combining content creation, video production, web development, brand design, and performance advertising.

The Design Dude Studio (TDDS) crafts commercial films, viral reels, CGI ads, custom websites, and digital brand experiences engineered for high conversion, brand equity, and algorithmic distribution.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [Content & Video Production](https://thedesigndudestudio.com/#services): Brand commercial films, high-retention viral reels, CGI & 3D motion ads, documentary brand stories, cinematic event coverage, and sound design.
- [Web Development](https://thedesigndudestudio.com/#services): Custom business websites, high-converting landing pages, e-commerce stores, interactive motion UI, and full-stack web applications.
- [Social Media Management](https://thedesigndudestudio.com/#services): Algorithmic content strategy, full account and grid management, short-form video production, and community growth.
- [Advertising & Performance](https://thedesigndudestudio.com/#services): Meta & Google ad management, high-conversion creative funnels, audience architecture, and ROAS scaling.
- [Branding & Visual Design](https://thedesigndudestudio.com/#services): Brand identity systems, logo design, packaging design, and web UI/UX art direction.
